title.zh: Solana Foundation Launches Open-Source Solana DvP With J.P. Morgan Input For Seconds-Scale Settlement
title.en: Solana Foundation Launches Open-Source Solana DvP With J.P. Morgan Input For Seconds-Scale Settlement

current_state.zh: The Solana Foundation launched an open-source DvP settlement framework, developed with J.P. Morgan input, enabling seconds-scale delivery-versus-payment for tokenized institutional transactions.
current_state.en: The Solana Foundation launched an open-source DvP settlement framework, developed with J.P. Morgan input, enabling seconds-scale delivery-versus-payment for tokenized institutional transactions.
